overview: The Zoning Board of Appeals approved variances for a hot tub and fence at 77 Sheppard Road and granted a special permit for Theory Wellness to add medical cannabis sales at 162 Mystic Avenue. The board also closed a hearing following the withdrawal of a special permit request for 106 Alexander Avenue and continued a hearing for 7 Terrell Road.

items.title: 7 Terrell Road
items.summary: Continued the public hearing on a special permit application for a side porch awning to March 26, 2026, at the applicant's request.

items.title: 106 Alexander Avenue
items.summary: Closed the hearing following the applicant's withdrawal of a special permit request for parking, noting that previously granted variances remain intact after revisions brought the parking plan into compliance.

items.title: 77 Sheppard Road
items.summary: Approved variances allowing an accessory structure (hot tub) in the front yard and a six-foot fence within the front yard setback, rejecting objections from an abutting neighbor regarding statutory hardship criteria.

items.title: 162 Mystic Avenue
items.summary: Approved a special permit allowing Theory Wellness to add medical marijuana sales to its existing recreational cannabis dispensary.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Board Membership
items.summary: Discussed upcoming meeting minutes, board member appointment processes, and member Mike Caldera's upcoming departure from the board in March.
